source.scope: 6.2.3 and 6.2.4, PDF pages 69-70 / printed pages 55-56, with necessary canonical dependencies
source.method: Read the original local PDF's scoped syntax and canonical literal, DATA, expression and interface definitions before consulting author reports. Compiler agreement was corroboration, not the source oracle.

constants.rationale: All scoped units are accounted for. Union/alias controls do not acquire ownership of detailed literal, PARAMETER, rank, repetition-count or assignment semantics. All twelve positives are conforming admission controls; all eight negatives reach C602 through real DATA-repeat syntax. Their shared facet tags remain true after isolation.
fixture_checks: R604_valid: distinct DATA values 5 and 7 are checked independently. R605 controls check integer 42, real 6, complex parts 2 and 3, both logical values, four characters of 'Ab c', and BOZ Z'2A' as integer 42.
R605_valid__boz.f90:8 uses a permitted integer DATA value, not an unrestricted expression or a repeat factor; no sign-bit-dependent interpretation is needed.
R606 controls use an actual scalar PARAMETER and a whole named array of size 3 with elements 2, 3, 5. Neither scalar rank nor integer type is attributed to the alias itself.
R607_valid.f90:8-9 expands to [5,5,9] and [7,7,7,12]. Extents, prior definition and every element/sentinel assertion agree.
C602 positive controls initialize [7,7]. INTEGER PARAMETER converted = 2.0 is legitimate initialization conversion; the repeat name has integer type.

C602_invalid.f90:8,14,20,26 and C602_invalid__named.f90:9,16,23,30 each have one noninteger repeat operand. Literals/names are scalar, names are previously defined, and the following DATA value is integer 7. No BOZ-context, subobject, ordinary-assignment or scalar-int-expr rule is substituted for R607/C602.
minimal_repairs: Literal cases: replace only the marked repeat operand by 2, obtaining two values for the two-element array.
Real/complex named cases: replace the PARAMETER type specification by INTEGER; the existing initializer 2 can remain.
Logical/character named cases: use INTEGER, PARAMETER :: repeats = 2. Both declaration and initializer must change. The matching controls check both resulting elements.

operators.rationale: The fine subdivisions account for the twelve union alternatives and eleven visible restatements without allocating new local canonical requirements. All twenty-four positives have conforming interfaces and justified result checks. The sole negative isolates a token outside the defined-operator union. Four target failures are compiler observations, not fixture defects.

fixture_checks: R608 covers all nine categories and 23 spellings. Small integer arithmetic, exact nonzero division, character concatenation and literal logical/relational tables give justified assertions. MERGE checks do not assume a logical storage representation.

R609 .shift. and .combine. have legal short letter-only names and one/two INTENT(IN) integer dummies; expected results are 12 and 47. The extended binary control returns 9; the extended unary controls check both flag values.

R610 has ten programs covering nine inherited categories. Unary/binary add forms are separated. All extensions use scalar derived-type operands with matching, nonoptional INTENT(IN) data dummies and permissible arity. Module/internal interfaces are explicit; the character result has explicit length 4. No intrinsic signature is replaced.

R610 integer results are 34 for the function-defined power operation, 54/6 for multiply/divide, 18/8 for binary add/subtract, and 7/-7 for unary add/subtract. Concatenation returns 'abCD'; relational/logical assertions agree with the helper implementations.
The relational extension samples < only. No precedence, complete type/kind/rank matrix, generic-resolution, type-bound-dispatch or all-relational-extension coverage is claimed.
The repair fixture credits only operator-generic-operand. Calling the helper directly is adequate for that admission facet and is not miscredited as a runtime operator-dispatch test.

assignment_symbol_pair.body_comparison: Exactly one operator token changes after excluding metadata/comments. Both bodies call sum_boxes directly and check 9.
assignment_symbol_pair.isolation: The two INTENT(IN) box dummies and integer function result satisfy the repaired binary-extension premises. The invalid token is the only independent defect.
assignment_symbol_pair.premise_correction: There is no ASSIGNMENT(=) control in either applied handoff. Merely changing this function's generic to ASSIGNMENT(=) would not be a conforming repair: defined assignment needs a subroutine and the required first/second dummy intents. Retain the actual valid OPERATOR(+) repair; claim no defined-assignment coverage.

diagnostic_review.required_basis: C602 is associated with R607 and propagates through R403/R847. OPERATOR(=) violates R1508's defined-operator position via R609. Their numbered syntax/constraint basis invokes 4.2 p2(3).
diagnostic_review.not_required_by_these_rules: Fatal rejection, exact severity, rule-number text and the suite's particular source-location contract are not additional language requirements. Clause 15 prose premises were checked for positive conformance, not promoted into new mandatory-diagnostic requirements.
diagnostic_review.crash_handling: tests/run_tests.py:274-281 and 518-522 classify timeout, ASR-verification failure and crash indicators before rejection judging. None of the examined report outputs contains a crash indication. Invalid report entries omit raw process traces, so this review does not claim a fresh independent exit-status measurement.
diagnostic_review.named_C602_target_caveat: All four named negatives produce a LFortran DATA element-count mismatch (2 objects, 1 value), not an integer-type diagnostic. These observations establish the runner's source-located rejection result, not demonstrated type-specific C602 checking. Flang explicitly diagnoses the noninteger named types. Do not infer a missing type checker, a mandatory diagnostic from the count-matching prose, or an independent fixture defect from the target message alone.

genuine_compiler_gaps.evidence: operators-author-target.json; current source/requirement/metadata fingerprints match. These are recorded observations, not a newly executed compiler run.
genuine_compiler_gaps.classification: Four source-conforming fixtures rejected across three operator forms; no compiler root-cause diagnosis is claimed.

cases.repair_direction: Correct processor handling of the valid unary defined operation; keep the fixture interfaces and expected logical results.

cases.operation: extended unary + on type(box), returning integer
cases.reported_error: Assignment type mismatch: integer and box
cases.repair_direction: Honor the valid defined function and its integer result; do not change the expected result type to match target behavior.

cases.reported_error: Left operand must be LOGICAL or LOGICAL array
cases.repair_direction: Correct processor handling of the valid binary defined operation; retain the literal truth-table assertions.

genuine_compiler_gaps.masking_limit: Compilation failure means no target runtime evidence for the bundled unary-minus or .EQV. assertions. Duplicate .NOT. failures are not evidence of two distinct implementation bugs.
genuine_compiler_gaps.constants: No conforming-program failure or silent acceptance was reported in this finite sample. The named-negative diagnostic caveat is not itself a verified compiler conformance gap.

nonblocking_limitations: Admission evidence is deliberately finite. No malformed-literal/member-token or alias-only invalid twin should be invented to simulate broader canonical coverage.
The R610 relational extension is a category sample, not complete synonym coverage. Positive runtime assertions do not promote the union/alias into an independently covered semantic rule.

For a future, separate investigation of named-repeat checking, a count-neutral one-element/one-repeat pair could distinguish a missing type check from the current count-error fallback. That strengthening is not required to repair these source-isolated fixtures.

Invalid-case raw process traces and input_hashes are empty in these existing reports. Container fingerprints and live isolation were checked, but no fresh compilation, full Python regression suite or toolchain-version remeasurement was performed under READ-ONLY.
Compiler versions are author-run snapshots. Reference success, including Flang's f2018 fallback, does not ratify the complete Fortran 2023 standard or any untested feature.

Both catalogues remain draft and all 39 fixtures remain unreviewed. The shared index addition remains unstaged; source-review eligibility here is not an approval or a global PDF/source-inventory review.
